patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality photography is used as primary content blocks and visual dividers between sections, often with text overlays.
Prominent, uppercase sans-serif typography is used for section titles and calls to action, creating a bold and editorial feel.
A high-contrast black and white base palette dominates the interface, allowing product photography to introduce the primary color variations.
The main navigation bar transitions from a transparent background to a solid black background on scroll, maintaining its sticky position, and a thin promotional banner appears at the very top.
Editorial-style product showcases use large, aspirational photography, mixed with more traditional grid-based product displays for browsing.

technique_notes: The sticky header transitions its background from transparent to solid black and reveals a top promotional banner as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Full-bleed, high-quality photography is used extensively to create immersive hero sections and visual breaks between content blocks, often with text overlays for branding or calls to action.
A minimalist typographic approach relies on strong contrast between large, uppercase sans-serif headings and smaller, regular-weight body text to establish hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are large, uppercase, and bold (~3-4x body) creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, regular-weight body and label text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, especially in hero and full-bleed image sections, becoming more balanced in product grids and footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, full-bleed, editorial-quality photography as primary content blocks, combined with a stark black-and-white color scheme and bold, uppercase typography, creates a sophisticated and high-fashion aesthetic that feels more like a magazine than a typical e-commerce site.
